description: This file defines a React functional component 'SessionItem' that represents an individual chat session item in a chat application. It includes UI elements such as icons, labels, and popovers for delete actions, and integrates drag-and-drop functionality with '@hello-pangea/dnd'. The component conditionally renders UI based on props like selection state and screen size.

methods.name: SessionItem
methods.description: React functional component that renders a chat session item with drag-and-drop, selection, and delete capabilities.
